name: ThreeDTriaxialEngine
description:
The engine perform a triaxial compression with a control in direction 'i' in stress (if stressControl_i) else in strain.

For a stress control the imposed stress is specified by 'sigma_i' with a 'max_veli' depending on 'strainRatei'. To obtain the same strain rate in stress control than in strain...

attributes.description: current strain rate in direction 1 - converging to

attributes.name: stressControl_2

attributes.name: stressControl_3

attributes.name: strainDamping
attributes.description: factor used for smoothing changes in effective strain rate. If target rate is TR, then (1-damping)*(TR-currentRate) will be added at each iteration. With damping=0, rate=target all the time. With damping=1, it doesn't change.

attributes.name: Key
attributes.description: A string appended at the end of all files, use it to name simulations.

attributes.name: stiffnessUpdateInterval
attributes.description: iteration period for measuring the resultant packing-boundaries stiffnesses, for stress servo-control

attributes.name: stressDamping
attributes.description: wall damping coefficient for the stress control - wallDamping=0 implies a (theoretical) perfect control, wallDamping=1 means no movement

attributes.name: max_vel
attributes.description: Order of magnitude of maximum allowed walls velocity during stress control [m/s]. The corresponding value superseeds the one assigned by the stress controller if the later is higher. max_vel can be set to infinity in many cases, but sometimes helps stabilizing packings. attributes.name: internalCompaction
attributes.description: Switch between 'external' (walls) and 'internal' (growth of particles) compaction.

attributes.name: meanStress
attributes.description: Mean stress in the packing. (auto-updated)

attributes.name: volumetricStrain
attributes.description: Volumetric strain (see strain). (auto-updated)

attributes.name: externalWork
attributes.description: Mechanical work associated to the boundary conditions, i.e. $ int_{ partial Omega} mat{T} cdot mat{u} ds$ with $ mat{T}$ the surface traction and $ mat{u}$ the displacement at the boundary. (auto-updated)

attributes.name: updatePorosity
attributes.description: If true, solid volume will be updated once (will automatically reset to false after one calculation step) e.g. for porosity calculation purpose. Can be used when volume of particles changes during the simulation (e.g. when particles are erased or when clumps are created).

attributes.name: strain
attributes.description: Current strain in a vector (exx,eyy,ezz). The values reflect true (logarithmic) strain.

attributes.name: strainRate
attributes.description: Current strain rate in a vector d/dt(exx,eyy,ezz).

attributes.name: porosity
attributes.description: Porosity of the packing, computed from particlesVolume and boxVolume. (auto-updated)

attributes.name: boxVolume
attributes.description: Total packing volume.

attributes.name: particlesVolume
attributes.description: Total volume of particles (clumps and dynamic spheres). |ycomp|

attributes.name: spheresVolume
attributes.description: Shorthand for particlesVolume

attributes.name: max_vel1
attributes.description: see max_vel |ycomp|

attributes.name: max_vel2
attributes.description: see max_vel |ycomp|

attributes.name: max_vel3
attributes.description: see max_vel |ycomp|

attributes.name: dead
attributes.description: If true, this engine will not run at all; can be used for making an engine temporarily deactivated and only resurrect it at a later point.

attributes.name: ompThreads
attributes.description: Number of threads to be used in the engine. If ompThreads<0 (default), the number will be typically OMP_NUM_THREADS or the number N defined by 'yade -jN' (this behavior can depend on the engine though). This attribute will only affect engines whose code includes openMP parallel regions (e.g. InteractionLoop). This attribute is mostly useful for experiments or when combining ParallelEngine with engines that run parallel regions, resulting in nested OMP loops with different number of threads at each level.

attributes.name: label
attributes.description: Textual label for this object; must be valid python identifier, you can refer to it directly from python.

attributes.name: execTime
attributes.description: Cumulative time in nanoseconds this Engine took to run (only used if O.timingEnabled == True).

attributes.name: execCount
attributes.description: Cumulative count this engine was run (only used if O.timingEnabled == True).

attributes.name: timingDeltas
attributes.description: Detailed information about timing inside the Engine itself. Empty unless enabled in the source code and O.timingEnabled == True.

methods.name: setContactProperties

methods.name: stress
methods.description: Returns the average stress on boundary 'id'. Here, 'id' refers to the internal numbering of boundaries, between 0 and 5.
